title: Bronchoscopic Management of Pediatric Patients with Suspected Foreign Body Aspiration: Data from a Retrospective Single-Center Study
summary:
When children accidentally inhale food or small objects, these can become trapped in the airways and cause health problems. Doctors may need to examine the airways with a special instrument to find and remove the object. This study will review existing medical records of children examined for suspected inhalation of a foreign object between 2016 and 2025. It will assess how often an object was found and successfully removed, as well as symptoms, test findings and complications. No additional tests
or treatments will be performed.
conditions: Suspected foreign body aspiration in children.

interventions.name: Single observational cohort: All patients younger than 18 years who underwent flexible and/or rigid bronchoscopy for suspected foreign body aspiration at University Medicine Essen – Ruhrlandklinik between January 1, 2016 and December 31, 2025.
